args: How should the face parsing loop in assimp/code/AssetLib/OFF/OFFLoader.cpp be safely structured so that malformed or missing face records cannot make aiMesh::mNumFaces disagree with the allocated and initialized aiFace elements? Please check whether another/upstream version of Assimp has a corresponding fix and describe exact code if known.

The current OFFImporter::InternReadFile allocates numFaces aiFace objects and initially assigns mesh->mNumFaces=numFaces. Its loop uses i as a valid-face counter, does not increment i for face-size 0 or >9, and decrements unsigned mNumFaces on every invalid record. This permits underflow after more malformed records than the declared face count. Also, GetNextLine failure breaks while leaving mNumFaces potentially larger than the number of initialized valid faces. I plan to separate the bounded number of records consumed from the valid face count, compact valid faces at the front of the allocation, and assign mNumFaces only after parsing.
